title: Indoor Playgrounds in Berlin - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **Adults pay too.** At JOLOs, Bambooland, Bim & Boom and Tommys an adult ticket costs **7.50 to 11 euros**, so price the whole family.
**One Saturday afternoon** for two adults and two small children runs from **23 euros** at the Labyrinth Kindermuseum to **50 euros** at Bambooland.
**School holidays cost weekend money** at JOLOs, Bim & Boom and Tommys. The Herbstferien run from **19 to 31 October**.
**Cheapest weekday window:** Bim & Boom is **half price from 17:00**, Tuesday to Friday, except on public holidays.
**Short stays at Bambooland** are billed per 10 minutes for children when you stay under 110 minutes.
**On a normal Monday** only Bambooland (from 12:00) and Tommys (from 14:00) are open.
**Bring socks for everyone** and book Tommys online: at the till each ticket is **5 euros more**.
